pattern-switch-concept-041.title: Use patterns in switch
pattern-switch-concept-041.short: Match values by type directly in switch
pattern-switch-concept-041.summary: Pattern matching for switch combines type tests, variable binding, and branch selection.
pattern-switch-concept-041.why: It replaces repeated instanceof-and-cast chains with an expression that makes the handled cases explicit.
pattern-switch-concept-041.tips: Order cases from more specific patterns to broader ones and include a suitable default when needed.

record-pattern-concept-041.title: Deconstruct records with patterns
record-pattern-concept-041.summary: Record patterns test a record type and extract its components in one pattern.
record-pattern-concept-041.why: They remove accessor boilerplate when code immediately needs the components of a matched record.
record-pattern-concept-041.tips: Nested record patterns can deconstruct structured data without temporary variables.

map-copy-of-code-041.title: Create an unmodifiable map snapshot
map-copy-of-code-041.short: Use Map.copyOf when callers must not mutate the result
map-copy-of-code-041.summary: Map.copyOf creates an unmodifiable map containing the current mappings of its source.
map-copy-of-code-041.why: It provides a clear ownership boundary when exposing configuration or snapshot data.
map-copy-of-code-041.tips: The result rejects mutation; copy it into HashMap later if a mutable working map is required.

unmodifiable-map-exception-041.title: Modify an unmodifiable map
unmodifiable-map-exception-041.short: Copies made by Map.copyOf reject mutation
unmodifiable-map-exception-041.summary: Mutating an unmodifiable map throws UnsupportedOperationException.
unmodifiable-map-exception-041.why: The map contract intentionally excludes structural modification operations.
unmodifiable-map-exception-041.tips: Keep the value unmodifiable when it is a snapshot, or explicitly create a mutable HashMap copy.

malformed-input-exception-041.title: Handle malformed encoded text
malformed-input-exception-041.short: Report invalid byte sequences while decoding
malformed-input-exception-041.summary: MalformedInputException indicates that input bytes do not form valid characters for the selected charset.
malformed-input-exception-041.why: External data may be truncated, corrupted, or encoded using a different charset.
malformed-input-exception-041.tips: Choose the charset deliberately and configure the decoder action according to whether replacement or rejection is appropriate.

pattern-switch-dominance-error-041.title: Place a dominated switch pattern
pattern-switch-dominance-error-041.short: A broader earlier pattern can make a later case unreachable
pattern-switch-dominance-error-041.summary: A pattern case is rejected when an earlier case already matches every value it could match.
pattern-switch-dominance-error-041.why: The later branch could never be selected, so the compiler reports the dominance error.
pattern-switch-dominance-error-041.tips: Put specific type patterns before broader supertypes.

generic-catch-alternative-error-041.title: Use related types in a multi-catch
generic-catch-alternative-error-041.short: Multi-catch alternatives cannot be subclasses of each other
generic-catch-alternative-error-041.summary: A multi-catch cannot list both an exception type and one of its subclasses.
generic-catch-alternative-error-041.why: The broader alternative already catches every value handled by the narrower one.
generic-catch-alternative-error-041.tips: Keep only the common supertype, or use separate catch blocks when different handling is required.

redundant-cast-warning-041.title: Write an unnecessary cast
redundant-cast-warning-041.short: Remove casts that do not change the expression type
redundant-cast-warning-041.summary: The cast lint warning can identify casts whose result is already known to have the requested type.
redundant-cast-warning-041.why: Redundant casts add noise and can hide which conversions are actually important.
redundant-cast-warning-041.tips: Remove the cast unless it documents a necessary overload or type-inference decision.

mutable-key-map-trap-041.title: Mutate a key after putting it in a map
mutable-key-map-trap-041.short: Hash-based keys need stable equality and hash codes
mutable-key-map-trap-041.summary: Changing fields used by equals or hashCode after insertion can make a key effectively unreachable in a HashMap.
mutable-key-map-trap-041.why: The entry remains in the bucket chosen from the old hash while later lookup uses the new hash.
mutable-key-map-trap-041.tips: Prefer immutable key objects whose equality-relevant state never changes.

charset-default-trap-041.title: Rely on the default charset
charset-default-trap-041.short: Specify the encoding at byte-text boundaries
charset-default-trap-041.summary: Constructing text without an explicit charset can make data interpretation depend on the runtime environment.
charset-default-trap-041.why: The producer and consumer must agree on an encoding for bytes to represent the intended characters.
charset-default-trap-041.tips: Use StandardCharsets.UTF_8 or another protocol-defined charset explicitly.
